description: This Java class named LogView extends TextView and implements LogNode. It is used for displaying log messages within an Android application, formatting log entries and outputting them to the TextView UI component. It handles formatting based on log priority levels, appending messages and exceptions, and chaining log nodes if needed.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: Custom TextView class that displays formatted log messages and implements the LogNode interface for logging chain functionality.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats incoming log data, converts priority to string, handles exceptions, and appends the formatted log line to the TextView. Runs UI updates on the main thread and forwards the log to the next node if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter, only if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView content.
